submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve precise running phase edit. ONE transparent full-body sprite, frame E11 in a16-frame run toward screen RIGHT. Input1 exact E11 EDIT TARGET; input2 confirmed character E identity; input3 primary approved painterly STYLE only. Keep target head face hair torso waist position scarf camera lighting proportions and design unchanged. Repair only legs and middle arm transition, retaining navy ivory gold costume silver bob purple eye and tiny hidden FAR LEFT hair ornament tip. Fixed square1254x1254 native if supported, minimum1024; virtual ground y94%, no whole-character moving, no bbox recenter/zoom.
Precise E11: anatomical LEFT leg is FAR SUPPORT leg. Move its planted boot from too far behind to DIRECTLY UNDER THE HIP, almost flat on virtual ground, knee compressed below pelvis. Anatomical RIGHT leg is NEAR RECOVERY leg, the knee passes UNDER the pelvis and only slightly ahead, NOT held high in front; fold this recovery lower leg BACK with heel pulled toward buttocks. Right boot is off ground, behind the support shin, both boots distinct. Near/right leg must visibly overlap far/left leg where needed; exactly2 legs and2 boots. Near/right ARM connects to the visible GOLD-DISC shoulder and begins retracting from forward extreme: bent elbow, fist a little in FRONT OF BELT instead of far ahead. Far/left arm moves from rear toward neutral, fist beside rear hip. Exactly TWO arms with continuous shoulder/elbow/wrist, exactly TWO hands, exactly TWO small crescent daggers, one securely gripped per hand, no floating dagger, no third hand. Preserve distinct hand silhouettes and grips. This is the LOW compressed passing stance between E10 landing and E12 heel lift, not a leaping high-knee stride. Both head and pelvis should remain at target positions; do not change face size or zoom. Preserve bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand painting and materials. True transparent RGBA, no scene, floor, shadows, text, grid, speed trails, attack effects. Configuration target GPT Image2.5 Sunburst/max, actual host route managed externally.
